answers.core:
Despite every [other](https://github.com/godotengine/godot-proposals/issues/545) [time](https://github.com/godotengine/godot-proposals/issues/843) [someone](https://github.com/godotengine/godot-proposals/issues/1720) [suggested](https://github.com/godotengine/godot-proposals/issues/2048) [changing](https://github.com/godotengine/godot-proposals/issues/2070) [the](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/issues/8946) [axes,](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/issues/17872) [being](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/issues/31066) [rejected](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/issues/8946#issuecomment-378936529), I believe all of them were misguided in a way we are not. They wished for some strange "Z" vertical axis, which is clearly wrong.

We are proposing here that Y remain the vertical axis, only that it be oriented the natural and correct way, as it always should have been!
In fact, this is more of [a](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/47259) [bug](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/issues/48832) [report](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/48859) than a proposal.
answers.workaround: Everyone will be on-board, so it will be used by everyone, all the time, as it should. No need for scripting, either!

title: Make 3D use the CORRECT vertical axis!
